name: feast-testing
title_zh: 调试特征仓库时先问它要跑哪条测试链
tagline_zh: 写新组件、查注册表不同步、线上存储报错——它不让你瞎试，直接告诉你该跑哪条测试、看哪个状态，少走三小时弯路。
tagline_en: New component, registry drift, online store error—it tells you exactly which test to run and what state to.
desc_en: How to test and debug Feast — running targeted tests, writing unit tests for new components, debugging registry and online store issues, and inspecting live feature store state. Use when writing tests for a new feature, debugging a failing test, investigating a runtime error, or verifying that a change works correctly end-to-end.
why_zh: 把 Feast 的调试路径拆成可执行分支：按症状定位测试入口、注册表与在线存储的检查点。
why_en: Turns Feast debugging into executable branches: symptom → test entry → registry/online-store checkpoint, not a pile of doc links.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Feast 自身的测试与调试流程，不处理数据质量、模型训练或部署问题。
limit_en: Only covers Feast's own test/debug flows, not data quality, training, or deployment. Requires local Feast env + pytest, Python client only.
title_en: Ask which test chain to run before debugging Feast
